meta.note: WEWAKE coercion corpus. Each script is decomposed into psychological elements. The engine scores which elements are present in a message and matches to the closest known script. Weights are tuned so that coercion signals (secrecy, authority+threat) dominate over surface keywords.
meta.sources: Patterns derived from I4C advisories, RBI/NPCI guidance, and documented 2024-2026 Indian cases (digital arrest, FedEx/courier, UPI collect-request, KYC, refund, job-fee, investment).

secrecy_demand.label: Tells you to keep it secret

isolation.label: Tries to isolate / keep you on the line

payment_demand.label: Asks you to pay / transfer / verify funds

credential_demand.label: Asks for OTP / PIN / Aadhaar / card

channel_shift.label: Moves you to WhatsApp / Skype / an app

install_demand.label: Asks you to install an app / APK

too_good.label: Promises a prize / refund / guaranteed return

too_good: you are eligible for a refund

scripts.name: Digital Arrest
scripts.tagline: Fake CBI/police/ED put you under 'virtual custody' over video call.
scripts.truth: There is NO such thing as a 'digital arrest' in Indian law. CBI, ED, Police, Customs and Judges NEVER arrest or interrogate anyone over a video call. No agency asks you to transfer money to a 'verification' or 'RBI escrow' account. Cut the call and dial 1930.
scripts.example: Sir, a parcel in your name has 200g MDMA. Mumbai Cyber Crime has issued an arrest warrant. You are under digital arrest. Stay on this Skype video call, do not tell your family, and transfer your funds to our RBI verification account for clearance.

scripts.name: FedEx / Courier Parcel
scripts.tagline: A 'courier company' says a parcel in your name holds drugs or contraband.
scripts.truth: Courier companies (FedEx, DTDC, Blue Dart) do NOT call about drugs in parcels or transfer you to police. Customs never demands payment over the phone. This is the opening move of a digital arrest. Hang up and verify with the courier's official website.
scripts.example: This is FedEx. A parcel booked in your name to Taiwan was intercepted with illegal items and your Aadhaar. I am transferring you to the Cyber Crime Branch. Download Skype to continue.

scripts.name: UPI Collect-Request / 'Receive Money'
scripts.tagline: Someone says they're PAYING you, but sends a request that DEBITS you.
scripts.truth: You NEVER enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE money — a PIN is only needed to PAY. NPCI banned person-to-person collect requests in Oct 2025 because of this exact scam. If someone asks you to approve a request or enter your PIN 'to get paid', it will debit you.
scripts.example: I'm sending the payment for your OLX item now. Just approve the collect request and enter your UPI PIN to receive the ₹8,000.

scripts.name: KYC / Account Block
scripts.tagline: Your bank/wallet 'KYC expired' — update now or your account is frozen.
scripts.truth: Banks and UPI apps NEVER ask you to update KYC via a link, an app you install, or by sharing OTP/PIN. 'Account will be blocked today' is a pressure tactic. Update KYC only inside the official bank app or at a branch.
scripts.example: Your SBI KYC has expired. Your account will be blocked in 2 hours. Click this link and install the verification app, then share the OTP to reactivate.

scripts.name: Refund / Payment Reversal
scripts.tagline: 'Support' says a payment failed and asks for OTP/PIN to 'refund' you.
scripts.truth: No bank, UPI app, or support agent will EVER ask for your OTP or UPI PIN to process a refund. A refund never requires your PIN. Anyone asking is stealing, not refunding.
scripts.example: This is HDFC UPI support. Your transaction failed. To process your ₹4,999 refund, share your 6-digit UPI PIN and the OTP you'll receive now.

scripts.name: Job Offer / Task Fee
scripts.tagline: A 'recruiter' offers a job but demands a deposit or registration fee.
scripts.truth: Legitimate employers NEVER charge a security deposit, registration, or training fee to hire you. Real recruitment does not move to WhatsApp/Telegram and demand advance payment. TCS, Amazon and others have issued notices that they never charge fees.
scripts.example: Congratulations, you're selected at TCS! Pay a refundable ₹15,000 security deposit today to confirm your joining. Message our HR on WhatsApp.

scripts.name: Investment / Lottery / Prize
scripts.tagline: Guaranteed returns, a lottery win, or 'double your money' offers.
scripts.truth: Guaranteed or 'doubled' returns and surprise lottery wins are scams. You cannot win a lottery you never entered. Real investments never guarantee returns. Any upfront 'release fee' for a prize is theft.
scripts.example: Congratulations! You've won ₹25 lakh in the KBC lottery. To release your prize, pay a ₹9,500 processing fee today and share your bank details on WhatsApp.
